finding: The help centre lists 406 articles in its sitemap and 410 article links across 21 categories and 87 folders.
supporting_evidence: Sitemap URL count and a crawl of every category and folder page; all 406 sitemap articles were found by the crawl, plus 4 more.
unknowns_and_assumptions: Why 4 linked articles are missing from the sitemap is unknown.

finding: The help centre has a NITRO category with folders: Meeting Intelligence (11), Signals (6), Rocketlane MCP (7), Documentation Agent (4), Policies and Governance (1), Nitro Credit Consumption (1).
unknowns_and_assumptions: Folder titles only; article content not yet read.

finding: The Microsoft Teams connection article is filed under NITRO > Meeting Intelligence, not under the Integrations category.
unknowns_and_assumptions: Filing location only; says nothing yet about the mechanism.

finding: The public developer index (llms.txt) lists API reference resources for Invoices, Companies, Resource Allocations, Time-Offs, Fields, Time Tracking, Space Documents, Budgets, Tasks, Custom Revenue Recognition Configs, Projects, Phases, Users and Spaces, plus a webhooks guide.
unknowns_and_assumptions: No meeting, transcript, signal or AI resource appears in this index. Whether such endpoints exist but are unlisted is UNKNOWN. A Companies description mentions an Addresses API that has no listed entry.

finding: The website sitemap lists 1,518 URLs, all on the host stage.rocketlane.com rather than www.rocketlane.com.
unknowns_and_assumptions: Stage host deliberately not probed (out of scope). Paths map to live www pages that return 200.

finding: The blog index (14 pages, 534 posts) does not list either supplied blog post, although both URLs return 200.
supporting_evidence: Paginated crawl of /blogs; supplied URLs fetched directly.
unknowns_and_assumptions: The blog index is not a complete enumeration; some relevant posts may only be reachable by link.

finding: The help centre's robots.txt and URL scheme (/support/solutions, /helpdesk/) match a hosted helpdesk product.
unknowns_and_assumptions: The helpdesk vendor is not confirmed; needs header or page-signature evidence in Phase 3.

finding: Rocketlane links a trust centre hosted by Sprinto, a security PDF on a Webflow CDN domain (cdn.prod.website-files.com), and careers hosted on Kula.
supporting_evidence: Links on the home and trust pages.
unknowns_and_assumptions: Hosting of the marketing site on Webflow is suggested by the CDN domain but not yet confirmed by headers. The Sprinto page returned 403 to plain HTTP.

finding: Rocketlane publishes help articles for a Rocketlane MCP server (7 articles).
unknowns_and_assumptions: Capabilities, authentication and tool list not yet read.
